invariants: confirmed Markdown and explicit human confirmation remain authority
planning reads paths and bounded metadata rather than private source bodies
commands come only from the versioned maintenance manifest
every maintenance writer declares its actual repository relative write owners
canonical memory is never an automatic write target
public starter never discovers private repositories providers checkpoints or runtime state
a plan id is valid only for its exact change token and ordered step ids
required validation must pass before checkpoint advancement
selected dependency failures block downstream commands; executed receipts exclude blocked steps and independent selected steps may continue
direct subsets do not expand execution scope; omitted prerequisites reuse existing inputs subject to the selected command checks
failed safe refresh preserves changed targets and retains snapshots for reconciliation when write attribution is unavailable
an unresolved manual candidate remains visible across later unrelated changes until an exact reject decision while defer retains it without repeated prompting for the same change token
Git remains the rollback owner for code schema and reviewed document changes
